2027-05-02.title: Sixth Sunday of Easter
readings: The gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on the Gentiles
The Lord has revealed to the nations his saving power (or: Alleluia)
No one has greater love than this, to lay down one's life for one's friends
2027-05-02.verse: This is my commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

2027-05-06.title: Thursday of the Sixth Week of Easter
readings: Paul stayed with Aquila and Priscilla and worked with them, and every sabbath he argued in the synagogue
The Lord has revealed to the nations his saving power (or: Alleluia)
You will have pain, but your pain will turn into joy
2027-05-06.verse: Very truly, I tell you, you will weep and mourn, but the world will rejoice; you will have pain, but your pain will turn into joy.

2027-05-09.title: The Ascension of the Lord
readings: As they were watching, he was lifted up, and a cloud took him out of their sight
God mounts his throne to shouts of joy: a blare of trumpets for the Lord (or: Alleluia)
God seated him at his right hand in the heavenly places (or: Ephesians 4:1–13, shorter form 4:1–7, 11–13)
The Lord Jesus was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God
2027-05-09.verse: They said, “Men of Galilee, why do you stand looking up toward heaven? This Jesus, who has been taken up from you into heaven, will come in the same way as you saw him go into heaven.”

2027-05-16.title: Pentecost Sunday
readings: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other languages
Lord, send forth your Spirit, and renew the face of the earth (or: Alleluia)
In the one Spirit we were all baptized into one body
Come, Holy Spirit (the Sequence is obligatory today and is sung before the Alleluia)
As the Father has sent me, so I send you. Receive the Holy Spirit
2027-05-16.verse: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other languages, as the Spirit gave them ability.

2027-05-23.title: The Most Holy Trinity
readings: The Lord is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath; there is no other
Blessed the people the Lord has chosen to be his own
You have received a spirit of adoption. When we cry, “Abba! Father!”
Baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit
2027-05-23.verse: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.

2027-05-30.title: The Most Holy Body and Blood of Christ (Corpus Christi)
readings: See the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you
I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord (or: Alleluia)
How much more will the blood of Christ … purify our conscience from dead works to worship the living God!
Praise, O Zion, praise your Saviour (shorter form from Ecce panis angelorum, Behold the bread of angels)
This is my body. This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many
2027-05-30.verse: While they were eating, he took a loaf of bread, and after blessing it he broke it, gave it to them, and said, “Take; this is my body.” Then he took a cup, and after giving thanks he gave it to them, and all of them drank from it.

2027-05-01.title: Saturday of the Fifth Week of Easter
readings: Come over to Macedonia and help us
Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth (or: Alleluia)
If the world hates you, be aware that it hated me before it hated you
2027-05-01.verse: If the world hates you, be aware that it hated me before it hated you.

2027-05-03.title: Saints Philip and James, Apostles
readings: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles
Their voice goes out through all the earth (or: Alleluia)
Have I been with you all this time, Philip, and you still do not know me?
2027-05-03.verse: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you all this time, Philip, and you still do not know me? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?”

2027-05-04.title: Tuesday of the Sixth Week of Easter
readings: Believe on the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved, you and your household
Your right hand delivers me, O Lord (or: Alleluia)
It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I do not go away, the Advocate will not come to you
2027-05-04.verse: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: it is to your advantage that I go away, for if I do not go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

2027-05-05.title: Wednesday of the Sixth Week of Easter
readings: What therefore you worship as unknown, this I proclaim to you
Heaven and earth are full of your glory (or: Alleluia)
When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth
2027-05-05.verse: When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth; for he will not speak on his own, but will speak whatever he hears, and he will declare to you the things that are to come.

2027-05-07.title: Friday of the Sixth Week of Easter
readings: Do not be afraid, but speak and do not be silent; for I am with you
God is king of all the earth (or: Alleluia)
No one will take your joy from you
2027-05-07.verse: So you have pain now; but I will see you again, and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take your joy from you.

2027-05-08.title: Saturday of the Sixth Week of Easter
readings: Apollos showed by the scriptures that the Messiah is Jesus
God is king of all the earth (or: Alleluia)
The Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and have believed
2027-05-08.verse: For the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.

2027-05-10.title: Monday of the Seventh Week of Easter
readings: Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you became believers?
Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth (or: Alleluia)
Take courage; I have conquered the world
2027-05-10.verse: I have said this to you, so that in me you may have peace. In the world you face persecution. But take courage; I have conquered the world!

2027-05-11.title: Tuesday of the Seventh Week of Easter
readings: I may finish my course and the ministry that I received from the Lord Jesus
Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth (or: Alleluia)
Father, glorify your Son so that the Son may glorify you
2027-05-11.verse: And this is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent.

2027-05-12.title: Wednesday of the Seventh Week of Easter · Sts Nereus and Achilleus; St Pancras
readings: Keep watch over yourselves and over all the flock, of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers
Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth (or: Alleluia)
Sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth
2027-05-12.verse: Sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth.

2027-05-13.title: Thursday of the Seventh Week of Easter · Our Lady of Fatima
readings: Keep up your courage! You must bear witness also in Rome
Protect me, O God, for in you I take refuge (or: Alleluia)
That they may become completely one
2027-05-13.verse: As you, Father, are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.

2027-05-14.title: Saint Matthias, Apostle
readings: The lot fell on Matthias; and he was added to the eleven apostles
He raises the poor from the dust, to make them sit with the princes of his people (or: Alleluia)
You did not choose me but I chose you
2027-05-14.verse: You did not choose me but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit, fruit that will last,

2027-05-15.title: Saturday of the Seventh Week of Easter
readings: He lived there two whole years and welcomed all who came to him, proclaiming the kingdom of God
The upright shall behold his face (or: Alleluia)
This is the disciple who is testifying to these things and has written them, and his testimony is true
2027-05-15.verse: Jesus said to him, “If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you? Follow me!”

2027-05-17.title: The Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of the Church
readings: I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers (or: Acts 1:12–14, All these were constantly devoting themselves to prayer, together with Mary the mother of Jesus)
Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God
Woman, here is your son. Here is your mother
2027-05-17.verse: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple whom he loved standing beside her, he said to his mother, “Woman, here is your son.” Then he said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.”

2027-05-18.title: Tuesday of the Seventh Week in Ordinary Time · St John I
readings: My child, when you come to serve the Lord, prepare yourself for testing
Commit your life to the Lord, and he will help you
Whoever wants to be first must be last of all and servant of all
2027-05-18.verse: He sat down, called the twelve, and said to them, “Whoever wants to be first must be last of all and servant of all.”

2027-05-19.title: Wednesday of the Seventh Week in Ordinary Time
readings: O Lord, great peace have they who love your law
Whoever is not against us is for us
2027-05-19.verse: But Jesus said, “Do not stop him; for no one who does a deed of power in my name will be able soon afterward to speak evil of me. Whoever is not against us is for us.”

2027-05-20.title: Thursday of the Seventh Week in Ordinary Time · St Bernardine of Siena
readings: Do not delay to turn back to the Lord
Blessed are they who hope in the Lord
It is better for you to enter life maimed than to have two hands and to go to hell
2027-05-20.verse: Do not delay to turn back to the Lord, and do not postpone it from day to day.

2027-05-21.title: Friday of the Seventh Week in Ordinary Time · St Christopher Magallanes and Companions
readings: Faithful friends are a sturdy shelter: whoever finds one has found a treasure
Guide me, Lord, in the way of your commands
What God has joined together, let no one separate
2027-05-21.verse: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.

2027-05-22.title: Saturday of the Seventh Week in Ordinary Time · St Rita of Cascia
readings: The Lord created human beings out of earth, and made them in his own image
The Lord's kindness is everlasting to those who fear him
Whoever does not receive the kingdom of God as a little child will never enter it
2027-05-22.verse: Let the little children come to me; do not stop them; for it is to such as these that the kingdom of God belongs.

2027-05-24.title: Monday of the Eighth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Turn back to the Lord and forsake your sins (Lectionary numbering: Sirach 17:20–24)
Let the just exult and rejoice in the Lord
Go, sell what you own, and give the money to the poor; then come, follow me
2027-05-24.verse: Jesus looked at them and said, “For mortals it is impossible, but not for God; for God all things are possible.”

2027-05-25.title: Tuesday of the Eighth Week in Ordinary Time · St Bede the Venerable; St Gregory VII; St Mary Magdalene de' Pazzi
readings: Give to the Most High as he has given to you, and as generously as you can afford
To the upright I will show the saving power of God
who will not receive a hundredfold now in this age … with persecutions … and in the age to come eternal life
2027-05-25.verse: With every gift show a cheerful face, and dedicate your tithe with gladness. Give to the Most High as he has given to you, and as generously as you can afford.

2027-05-26.title: Saint Philip Neri, Priest
readings: Then they will know, as we have known, that there is no God but you, O Lord
Show us, O Lord, the light of your kindness
The Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many
2027-05-26.verse: For the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many.

2027-05-27.title: Thursday of the Eighth Week in Ordinary Time · St Augustine of Canterbury
readings: By the word of the Lord his works are made; who could ever tire of seeing his glory?
By the word of the Lord the heavens were made
My teacher, let me see again. Go; your faith has made you well
2027-05-27.verse: Then Jesus said to him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “My teacher, let me see again.”

2027-05-28.title: Friday of the Eighth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: These also were godly men, whose righteous deeds have not been forgotten
The Lord takes delight in his people
My house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations. Have faith in God
2027-05-28.verse: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father in heaven may also forgive you your trespasses.

2027-05-29.title: Saturday of the Eighth Week in Ordinary Time · St Paul VI, Pope
readings: While I was still young, before I went on my travels, I sought wisdom openly in my prayer
The precepts of the Lord give joy to the heart
By what authority are you doing these things?
2027-05-29.verse: More to be desired are they than gold, even much fine gold; sweeter also than honey, and drippings of the honeycomb.

2027-05-31.title: The Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
readings: The King of Israel, the Lord, is in your midst
Great in your midst is the Holy One of Israel
Why has this happened to me, that the mother of my Lord comes to me?
2027-05-31.verse: And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her by the Lord.
